model_binding_rule: Replay may report PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED/UNVERIFIED. Model-sensitive fresh evidence is non-promotable unless the private frozen execution manifest plus runtime receipt prove the predeclared observed model/reasoning/tools/environment binding; requested model text is not proof.
production_activation_rule: CURRENT_ACTIVE_COHORT_AND_G_MUST_EXACTLY_MATCH_STAGED_CANDIDATE_AND THE ROLE NORMALIZED_FIRST_PRODUCTION_UTC MUST PASS; EARLY DOWNSTREAM HOURLY WAKES ARE HEARTBEAT_ONLY
scheduler_readback_rule: API_SUCCESS_IS_NOT_PROOF; NORMALIZED_RETURNED_TASK_CONFIGURATION_MUST_MATCH_FROZEN_SCHEDULER_MANIFEST; UTC OCCURRENCES ARE DERIVED FROM EXACT VANCOUVER HOURLY GRAMMAR AND FROZEN REGISTRY MINUTE
preactivation_status_time_rule: TRUSTED GITHUB STATUS CREATED_AT MUST FALL WITHIN THE SIGNED SCHEDULED CHALLENGE PLUS MAX_ATTEMPT_AND_JITTER WINDOW AND NO LATER THAN ADMISSION_CUTOFF
worker_write_rule: When candidate is inactive, read main:state/STAGED.json and bind its exact blob, R, G, nonce, and scheduler-manifest blob; create exactly one receipt commit on the dedicated ps/preactivate branch, open or reuse exactly one non-draft PR to the exact ps/gen base, and stop only after exact-head supernova/preactivation-admission is terminal. When active, read CURRENT then exact frozen G and write exactly reports/<cohort>/<role>.json on assigned production branch. Whole-report HMAC-2. No main writes.
verifier_write_rule: MM06 writes a closed source receipt without self commit/blob fields on ps/preactivate/<cohort>/MM06, bound to pointer blob plus R/G/manifest, opens or reuses the exact preactivation PR, and observes its exact-head trusted terminal status. A later create-once main admission envelope records the already-existing H/blob and source-bound supernova/preactivation-admission success. Production verification remains verification/<cohort>.json on ps/verify/<cohort> only and uses the non-merge supernova/branch-report-admission context.
integrator_write_rule: Require MM06 safe refs and source-bound supernova/branch-report-admission=success on the exact verifier head; construct candidate in memory, validate live/schema/semantic bindings, then create once on ps/integrate/<cohort>.
integrator_preactivation_write_rule: The existing MF06 task signs exactly one role-authenticated preactivation receipt on ps/preactivate/<cohort>/MF06 using its separately committed MF06 preactivation key, opens or reuses the exact preactivation PR, and observes its exact-head trusted terminal status; this is one of the canonical 15 tasks and creates no lane.
director_write_rule: For BIL00 preactivation, create exactly one role-authenticated receipt commit, open or reuse the exact preactivation PR, and observe its exact-head trusted terminal status. For staging, create exact four-path one-commit generation G from R, then open a pointer-only ps/stage/<cohort> PR and stop. Admission is a later create-once ps/admit/<cohort> PR. Promotion is later still, requires admission already in base unchanged, and uses state.expected_base_head as the later promotion CAS distinct from R. No force/rebase/bypass.
research_rule: BIL00 only at 00:58 and 12:58, and only when an accepted open research lane exists. While T0 is unqualified, T0 transport/repository/admission closure is the only admissible research lane; all other hourly BIL00 runs are director, liveness, issue-consolidation and guarded-repair runs.
